comments.body:
Thanks for the fix, Alex 🙏

This is a valid bug and the change looks right to us.

One small ask before we merge:  Please add a case to `backend/tests/test_converter_node.py` for CRLF inside a quoted field. For example, `'name,note\r\nAda,"line1\r\nline2"\r\n'` should return `[{"name": "Ada", "note": "line1\r\nline2"}]`. The description says line endings inside quoted fields are kept, and this case locks in the CRLF side of that.

Happy to merge once that is in.

Added the case you suggested. It checks that the converter returns `line1\r\nline2` unchanged inside the quoted field.

This comment was drafted with an AI coding assistant.
